# Lykke Studios

> Award-winning indie game studio creating meditative puzzle games for Apple Arcade, Nintendo Switch, and iOS platforms.

Lykke Studios is a creative game development studio based in Scotland that specializes in casual, family-friendly puzzle games with artistic aesthetics. The studio has built a portfolio of critically acclaimed titles available on Apple Arcade and other platforms, with a strong commitment to accessibility and user privacy.

## Featured Games

- [puffies.](https://www.lykkestudios.com/puffies): Puzzle game with puffy stickers on Apple Arcade for iPhone and iPad
- [Tint.](https://www.lykkestudios.com/tint): Watercolor painting puzzle game with meditative gameplay on Apple Arcade
- [Stitch.](https://www.lykkestudios.com/stitch): Embroidery puzzle game featuring creative gameplay on Apple Arcade
- [Lumen.](https://www.lykkestudios.com/lumen): Light and mirrors puzzle game, iOS exclusive casual game by Lykke Studios
